new.title: Tag picker — old Badge contract survives the Tag replacement
new.text: The implementation imports Tag and exposes TagTone, including gray/brown/pink; the page still calls option tone a Badge tone, while the spec anatomy, size row and Decisions still name Badge. The later feedback records the replacement, so these current contract sections should be reconciled.

new.title: Tag picker — conditional hint documented as unconditional
new.text: Without onCreate, the default heading is Select tags; with onCreate it is Select a tag or create one. The page gives only the latter as the default. Document both branches.

new.title: Tag and corner setting — Sharp remove plate stays rounded
new.text: The Tag shell goes square at radius 0, but the remove control floors its corner at the fixed space-2. This contradicts the corner setting’s square-everywhere contract. Derivation: max(2px, 0px − 2px) = 2px. Recommend using the radius floor or another Sharp-aware nested recipe after owner review.

new.title: Disclosure — current inset equation retains pre-change spacing
new.text: The current Anatomy/inset equations still say divided trigger/content padding 16 (compact 12); the corrected Decisions and CSS now use 10 (compact 8). The historical 2026-10-02 Visual pass can stay dated, but the live equation needs updating.

new.title: Card — current corner table predates the new setting
new.text: The current Decisions table still gives 22/24/28 and a Button-plus-text-column formula. Current CSS derives the corner from radius-container plus the inset term: at default radius 8 and default density, surface 12 plus 2/4/8 gives 14/16/20 for sm/md/lg. Compact is 10/12/14. Update the formula and default table; do not change the new corner behavior to match stale prose.

new.title: Alignment picker — removed size and stretch still in spec
new.text: React keeps size/stretch only as ignored compatibility inputs; the manifest has neither size nor stretch and CSS fills its parent. The spec Variants still offers sm/md/lg and stretch, and current inset equations still prescribe an 80px square. Update those contract sections to the responsive model recorded later in the feedback.

new.title: Date picker — calendar locale/week-start default differs from page
new.text: The page says browser locale and locale-derived week start. DatePicker passes possibly-undefined locale and firstDayOfWeek into Calendar, whose defaults are en-US and Sunday (0). Its outer date label uses Intl with the possibly-undefined locale, so an implicit non-US browser locale can disagree with the calendar. Recommend one documented locale/week-start policy and an explicit propagation decision.

new.title: Tag — compact dimensions absent from current contract
new.text: Spec and page give sm 20 / md 24 and a 16px remove box without density qualification. CSS reads mark-label-md/lg, which become 16/20 in compact; the remove box becomes 12/16. This is documentation drift, not evidence that compact scaling is wrong. Document the compact mapping explicitly.
